name: Frosted Cups
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality plastic, offering a lightweight, durable, and practical design for parties, celebrations, and everyday drink service.
    - Features a stylish frosted finish that gives the cups a clean, modern, and elegant appearance.
    - Designed with a smooth edge for a more comfortable drinking experience.
    - Lightweight and easy to handle, making them suitable for both casual and event use.
    - Built in a stackable, space-saving shape for convenient storage and transport.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

             + 16 oz

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a drink cup and a personalized party decoration.
    - Suitable for cold beverages such as water, soda, juice, cocktails, mocktails, beer, and party drinks.
    - Great for weddings, birthdays, anniversaries, reunions, graduations, holiday parties, and family gatherings.
    - Ideal for custom party tables, drink stations, event favors, and celebration décor.
    - Lightweight and practical for both indoor and outdoor use.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A fun personalized choice for couples, families, friends, coworkers, party hosts, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for weddings, engagement parties, birthdays, anniversaries, retirement parties, graduations, and holiday celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone planning a custom event or looking for stylish personalized drinkware.
    - Great as party favors, celebration accessories, and memorable custom event pieces.
    - A practical and attractive personalized item that adds charm to any special occasion 🥂🎉

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
